ICS 70.100.99FAD 31Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard specifies the guidelines for raising, absorption and testing of various diagnostic antisera used for serotyping of Vibrio cholerae. This is the guidance document and the actual method may vary depending on the manufacturing procedures validated by individual manufacturers.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards listed below:IS 6850 : 2023 Specification for agar, microbiological grade (first revision)
